cause: The probe package.json was written with a UTF-8 BOM, so native installation validation rejected it: SyntaxError: Unexpected token '﻿'
hostBehaviour: The manager restored package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml and node_modules; nothing was left half-installed
fix: Rewrote package.json and cordis.patch.yml as BOM-less UTF-8 and re-installed
note: Authoring error in a disposable test package, not a defect in the review service
